items.title: Business Plan
items.description: The Business Plan lacks information and criteria listed in the guidelines on the application portal. It requires a detailed management structure showing allocated responsibilities, controls and identification of key persons, detailed information on the business rationale, provision of information about payment gateways, contractual and financial model with key suppliers. It also lacks a detailed 3 year financial projection which is expected to indicate a break down of investments, the projected marketing expenses, wages, any commissions paid to any platform/content provider, and any loans paid, amongst key figures. Kindly review the business plan guidelines and resubmit
